description: The autonomy.grant refusal for a merge grant missing the forced condition (S56 T6, the -31833 family): an irreversible action (forge.merge) must carry the merge rule (requireGates) — it is forced on and cannot be turned off, because a merge that skips the rule is the exact failure the authority exists to prevent. The validator refuses a request that turns the condition off rather than silently correcting it; a grant is never fixed up, it is accepted or refused.

data.what: forge.merge must carry the merge rule (requireGates); it is forced on and cannot be turned off
data.means: a grant is a human-authored authority record with closed rules (subject, conditions, expiry, the node it may sit on); a request outside them is refused, not silently corrected — nothing was written
data.todo: the refusal names the rule it broke and the thing it broke it on; `autonomy.vocabulary` lists the closed sets a request may name
